page.layout: One column of running text, centred on the page; below it at the right a catchword "In". No running head, no page number. Show-through at the right edge and speckles are not printed text.

main_text.l: non parum lucis hinc affulget; nam præter-
quâ quod varios terminos, qui in Theologia
passim occurrunt accuratè explicet, etiam
quæ de Deo, Angelis, & Animâ ratio-
nali, naturali intellectus lumine conci-
pi possint, perspicuâ brevitate tradit,
unde non immerito Theologia naturalis
nuncupatur: ne vero in pervestigandis[?] divi-
nis intellectus noster erret, Author noster
ubique follicitè admodum observavit, ut
philosophiæ veritas, veritati divinæ semper
respondeat, & illa huic ancilletur: itaque
in hoc opere nihil nisi fortasse ultima li-
ma desiderari potest. Vos igitur quibus
abundè satis solida D. Burgersdicij eru-
ditio innotescit, eo affectu eum in hoc di-
gnissimo-ingenii sui factu revivisentem[?]
excipite, quo hunc docentem audivistis; &
qui semper cum applausu doctissima no-
stri Authoris, quæ publici juris sunt,
scripta excepistis, operis hujus posthumi
etiam tutores estote.

page.notes: "pervestigandis" and "revivisentem" are hard to read at this resolution; the letters are copied as far as they can be seen. The hyphenated "gnissimo-ingenii" is printed with a dash, which is kept. Printed text elsewhere is not visible.
